summary: References a Cache POP and outputs one cached data set selected by Cache Index. Index 0 selects the current cached frame and negative values select older cached frames.

key_params.name: cachepop
key_params.note: Cache POP to fetch snapshots from

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Cache index; 0 current, negative values older

key_params.name: cacheindexunit
key_params.note: Index unit such as raw index, frames, or seconds

key_params.name: interp
key_params.note: Interpolate cached frames when point counts match

key_concepts: References a Cache POP and outputs one cached snapshot selected by Cache Index.
Cache Index uses Cache POP history addressing: 0 selects current data and negative values select older data.
Out-of-range indices clamp to the available cache range rather than wrapping.
Interpolation can blend between cached frames when the cached snapshots have matching point counts.
common_gotchas: Positive indices are not the normal access pattern; out-of-range values clamp to the cache range.
Interpolated output needs matching point counts, otherwise the nearest cached frame is used.
The referenced Cache POP must be actively holding the history you expect.
